tasks.instruction: Implement `is_prime(n: int) -> bool` that returns True if n is prime and False otherwise.
Implement `slugify(text: str) -> str` converting text to a lowercase ASCII slug with words separated by single hyphens.
constraints: Collapse repeated hyphens and strip leading or trailing hyphens

tasks.instruction: Implement `chunk_list(items: list, size: int) -> list[list]` that splits items into consecutive sublists of at most `size` elements.
constraints: Return an empty list when items is empty
